title: Unify GraphQL Mutations and Remove JSON Scalars
description: Refactor compose/graphql so the schema uses explicit GraphQL kinds instead of JSON primitives, replace the fragmented mutation surface with a clean nested mutation that batches arbitrary commands without repeating shared identifiers, and adjust compose/rs plus compose/js to match. Validate with relevant tests and runtime-facing checks.
summary: Replaced the compose GraphQL SDL mutation surface with a nested `kitStore.batch` command API and removed `JSON` from the schema, added a typed batch executor path in `compose/rs`, and migrated the JS GraphQL transport plus design/store command helpers to the new batch mutation path while preserving existing client call sites.
